abilities.name: Command Override
abilities.text: QA only: once per turn, reroll any failed test.

abilities.name: Tactical Superiority
abilities.text: QA only: add +3 to all battle rolls.

abilities.name: Full Arsenal Access
abilities.text: QA only: carry unlimited gear, artifacts, followers, and consumables for overflow testing.

abilities.name: Deathless Protocol
abilities.text: QA only: the first time MASTER ALPHA would be defeated, set wounds to 1 instead.

abilities.name: System Test Mode
abilities.text: QA only: at the start of each turn choose one: gain 5 salvage, heal 3 wounds, draw gear, draw artifact, or move to an adjacent legal tile.
